local farm = GameInfo.Improvements["IMPROVEMENT_FARM"].Index
local function eligible(p)
  if p == nil or p:GetOwner() ~= 0 or p:GetFeatureType() >= 0 or p:GetResourceType() >= 0
      or p:GetImprovementType() >= 0 or p:GetDistrictType() >= 0 then return false end
  local t = GameInfo.Terrains[p:GetTerrainType()].TerrainType
  if t ~= "TERRAIN_GRASS" and t ~= "TERRAIN_PLAINS" then return false end
  return ImprovementBuilder.CanHaveImprovement(p, farm, 0) == true
end
local function ringOk(x, y, fx, fy)
  local d = Map.GetPlotDistance(x, y, fx, fy)
  return d >= 1 and d <= 2 and eligible(Map.GetPlot(fx, fy))
end
local spots = {
  {70, 22, {{68, 23}}, {{69, 22}}},
  {73, 30, {{74, 30}}, {}},
  {67, 24, {{68, 23}}, {{66, 22}}},
}
for _, s in ipairs(spots) do
  local n = 0
  for _, v in Players[0]:GetUnits():Members() do
    if v:GetX() == s[1] and v:GetY() == s[2]
        and GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()].UnitType == "UNIT_BUILDER"
        and v:GetBuildCharges() == 3 and v:GetMovesRemaining() > 0 then n = n + 1 end
  end
  local near = true
  for _, t in ipairs(s[3]) do
    local d = Map.GetPlotDistance(s[1], s[2], t[1], t[2])
    if d < 1 or d > 2 then near = false end
  end
  for _, r in ipairs(s[4]) do
    if not ringOk(s[1], s[2], r[1], r[2]) then near = false end
  end
  if n == 1 and near then print("OK|builder|" .. s[1] .. "," .. s[2] .. "|charges 3|work within 2")
  else print("ERR|builder at " .. s[1] .. "," .. s[2] .. ": found " .. n
             .. ", work within 2 = " .. tostring(near)) end
end

local function hostileNear(x, y)
  for i = 1, 63 do
    local p = Players[i]
    if p ~= nil and p:IsAlive() and (i == 63 or diplo:IsAtWarWith(i)) then
      for _, u in p:GetUnits():Members() do
        if Map.GetPlotDistance(x, y, u:GetX(), u:GetY()) <= 1 then return true end
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end
